Build full Input-Output table and code registry

build_full_io_table.Rd

Combines Intermediate Consumption, Final Demand, and Added Value into a single complete matrix, along with a Code Registry that maps each code to label, type, and row/column position.

Usage

build_full_io_table(
  sector,
  intermediate_consumption_m,
  final_demand_m,
  final_demand_component,
  added_value_m,
  added_value_lookup
)

Arguments

sector

A data frame or tibble with at least one column of sector names.

intermediate_consumption_m

Numeric matrix of intermediate consumption.

final_demand_m

Numeric matrix of final demand.

final_demand_component

Data frame or tibble with two columns: code and label for final demand components.

added_value_m

Numeric matrix of added value.

added_value_lookup

Data frame or tibble with two columns: code and label for added value components.

Value

A list with elements:

full_io_table

Complete IO matrix (rownames/colnames = labels)

code_registry

Tibble with code mapping (Code column kept as-is)

n_sector

Number of sectors

Details

The returned `full_io_table` uses **labels** (sector names, FD names, VA names) as row/column names, so it is human-readable. The `code_registry` retains the original numeric codes for internal mapping.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
full <- build_full_io_table(sector, ic, fd, fd_comp, av, av_lookup)
} # }
